[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]3,000 (Sandbox) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |spawned_by = [[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Freeze}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Swipe}}''' - The '''Yeti''' swipes at a nearby tower, stunning it for a short period of time. }} {{QuoteContainer|{{QuoteBox|He emerges from his cave...|Beginning of Wave 12 ([[Village of Despair]])}}}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Yeti''' is an enemy that exclusively appeared in [[Village of Despair]] as part of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, It walked at a similar speed to the [[Deep Freeze (Village of Despair)|Deep Freeze]] but it had more health, making the '''Yeti''' much more difficult to defeat. Additionally, it could perform its ''Swipe'' attack, stunning a single tower for a period of time. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Yeti's''' appearance is quite similar to the [[Deep Freeze (Village of Despair)|Deep Freeze]] as they are about the same size. The '''Yeti''' has light blue skin, and its torso and legs are white. It has blue crystals on its arms, white claws and black horns, as well as a white neckguard. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Yeti''' is similar to the second version, except it had a snarling face with blue eyes. }} ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Village of Despair]] during its event is listed instead. *Try to avoid placing towers near the path as they are prime targets for the '''Yeti'''. **However, you can sacrifice an unimportant tower to distract the '''Yeti''', such as the [[Scout]], as it is momentarily immobilized when attacking a tower. *As with the [[Deep Freeze (Village of Despair)|Deep Freeze]], when this spawns, you should have plentiful amounts of [[Minigunner]]s, [[Ranger|Outlaws]] and [[Turret]]s. **If required, you might need the [[Commander]] to boost the firerate of these towers. *The '''Yeti''' cannot be frozen by the [[Freezer]] and [[Frost Blaster]], including the [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Age''. **If you want to slow the '''Yeti''' down, then you can use the [[Pyromancer]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Yeti.png|First version (24 December 2019 – 26 January 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyYeti.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (3 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} YetiIconIG.png|'''Yeti''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Yeti''' used the {{RLinkC|209995252|Blizzard Beast Mode}} face from the Roblox Catalog. *The design of the '''Yeti''' could be based on the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Yeti|Yeti]] from ''Tower Battles''. *In Himalayan folklore, the [[wp:Yeti|Yeti]] is a large ape-like creature inhabiting the Himalayan mountain range. ==Update History== *'''24 December 2019''' - [[Release v1.5|Release v1.5.0]] **'''Yeti''' added. *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]] **'''Yeti''' removed. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **'''Yeti''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Yeti]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from [[Frost Mode]]. **Due to changes made with updates, its face has been removed. **Due to changes made with updates, its health has decreased from 4,000 to 3,000. **{{Bug}} ''Swipe'' no longer has a cooldown. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. {{VillageOfDespair|[[Present (Village of Despair)|Present]]|Wave 11|Yeti|Wave 12|[[Frost Tank]]|Wave 13}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
